channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ian Clark | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ian Clark from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Ian Clark
item.description:
Rajon Rondo on replacing Ian Clark's minutes at backup point guard:

“I think we're signing somebody else. It's the Pelicans, so we'll probably have someone else in here in a couple hours and we'll go from there.”

Rajon Rondo on Ian Clark, Apr 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Draymond Green on Ian Clark
item.description:
“Me and Ian Clark were talking a few weeks ago, and we were like, 'Yo, he really plays with us now!'”

Draymond Green on Ian Clark, Feb 11, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Ian Clark
item.description:
Ethan Sherwood Strauss:Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry lifting Ian Clark in celebration:

“What are you doing?! I thought you were injured. Hopefully he'll have just as much joy but not as much display, physically of that joy.”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Ian Clark, Apr 29, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.
